## {.bbn-slide}

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

bbnGridData = FileAttachment("data/bbn_grid.json").json()

bbnApp = {
  if (!window.BBNGrid || !window.BBNUI) {
    const node = document.createElement("div");
    node.className = "bbn-game bbn-game-error";
    node.innerHTML = "<div class='bbn-error-title'>JS-модули не загрузились</div><p class='bbn-error-text'>Проверь js/bbn-grid.js и js/bbn-ui.js.</p>";
    return node;
  }
  const app = window.BBNUI.createApp(bbnGridData, {
    showUniverseButton: true,
    showAutoButtons: true,
    initial: {eta10: 3.0, S: 0.82, tau_n: 800},
    footerHtml: `Вычисления основаны на пакете <a href="https://github.com/vallima/PRyMordial">PRyMordial</a>`
  });
  invalidation.then(() => {
    if (app.cleanup) app.cleanup();
  });
  return app;
}
```
